claim_boundary: Phase A operational latency microbenchmarks measured on first-window-per-test-flow samples with batch size 1, warm-up iterations, and CUDA synchronization. Evaluates traffic collection delay (physical clump network observation time), sequence preprocessing, and PyTorch model forward pass. Traffic collection delay is derived from clump timestamps/durations; preprocessing and inference are timed in-memory without disk I/O. End-to-end latency represents the sum of aligned per-sample components.
